# pland-cli

> Inofficial, agent-native CLI for the pland.app API — HR, time tracking, payroll/salaries, absences, invoices, offers, customer objects, quality control, documents. 529 commands across 53 resource groups, generated from pland.app's OpenAPI spec, with `--json` output built for AI agents. Python 3.11+ CLI, Apache-2.0-licensed. Not affiliated with pland.app.

pland-cli lets developers and AI agents drive the pland.app API from the terminal. Every command speaks `--json` for machine-readable output; a hand-maintained enrichment overlay works around unreliable server-side filters (date ranges, object filters) and returns correct results. Agents can introspect rather than guess via `pland describe <group> <command>` and `pland schema <Name>`, and install a curated skill with `pland skill install --agent claude|codex`.

## Key docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli/blob/main/README.md): Install, quickstart, command discovery, enriched commands, gotchas, profiles, maintenance.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli/blob/main/SECURITY.md): API-key handling, data-redaction rules, private reporting channel.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Dev setup, regenerating commands from the OpenAPI spec, the enrichment overlay.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release notes.

## Install

```
uv tool install git+https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli
# one-off, no install:
uvx --from git+https://github.com/yell-services/pland-cli pland --help
```

Not on PyPI yet — install from GitHub. Requires Python ≥ 3.11.

## Quickstart

```
export PLAND_API_KEY="<id>:<secret>"     # or: pland auth set-key
pland --json users active
```

## Command discovery (529 commands — don't guess)

- `pland --help` (53 groups) · `pland <group> --help`
- `pland describe <group> <command>` — method, path, parameters
- `pland schema <Name>` — e.g. `pland schema Absence`
- Always pass `--json` for machine-readable output.

## Enriched commands (prefer over the generic ones)

```
pland --json salary for-object --object-id <id> --from <d> --to <d>
pland --json salary monthly-report --object-id <id> --year 2024 --month 4
pland --json time-tracking in-range --from <d> --to <d>
pland --json absences in-range --from <d> --to <d>
pland --json invoice drafts --object-id <id>
pland --json documents upload <pdf> --kind faktura|regular
pland --json users active
pland --json pay-types wage <id>
```

## Gotchas

- Timestamps are Unix milliseconds.
- Server-side `from`/`to` and `objectId` filters are unreliable — use the enriched commands (client-side filtered) instead.
- For writes (POST/PATCH/DELETE), preview with `--dry-run` first, then run without the flag.
